settings.title: Jungle Climb
settings.style_prompt: cinematic documentary photograph, natural light, lush saturated greens, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain

scenes.image_prompt: A lean man in his thirties with short black hair, a sweat-soaked olive t-shirt and khaki cargo trousers, gripping a thick hanging vine as he climbs the trunk of a towering moss-covered kapok tree, bare feet braced against the bark, deep in a dense tropical rainforest; low-angle shot looking up the trunk, the man in the upper third of the frame, the canopy spreading above him; hazy shafts of sunlight piercing the leaves, humid mist, vivid greens
scenes.voiceover_text: Thirty meters up, the canopy hides everything he needs. [exhales sharply] One slip… and there's no second chance.
scenes.sfx_prompt: Bark creaking and leaves rustling close by as hands grip a vine, dense rainforest ambience with buzzing insects, distant howler monkeys calling
scenes.notes: Slow upward zoom suits this shot. If you want real climbing footage, drop a clip on this scene from the Library.
